en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2780 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked Imam Abu Ibrahim (as) about a person performing tamattu‘ who is an elderly man or a woman fearing menstruation—can they perform the tawaf for Hajj earlier, before going to Mina?
Imam (as) said: "Yes, for someone in such a situation, they may perform it earlier."

Imam (as) was also asked about a man who enters ihram for Hajj in Mecca, then sees the Kaaba empty and decides to perform tawaf before leaving for Mina.
Imam (as) said: "No."
